id: title:Gilbert09:skip webhook cleanup when the connected account is gone

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe webhook deletion workflow: P1.F1.H1 adds a try/except ValueError block to prevent the webhook deletion process from aborting when Stripe API credentials are unavailable, allowing the Hog function to report a graceful skip rather than failing. P1.F2.H1 is omitted as no established relationship exists between the two PRs.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 demonstrates a substantive, bounded reliability improvement by catching a specific exception during Stripe webhook cleanup and returning a structured failure result instead of propagating an unhandled error. This prevents the deletion workflow from aborting when OAuth credentials are unavailable, allowing the Hog function to remain disabled while reporting a graceful skip.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on P1.F1.H1. No relationship between P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 is established, and P1.F2.H1 is omitted. The benefit relies on the assumption that Stripe webhook deletion is a critical path; while the code change is substantive, the broader systemic impact is not demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 shows a production change adding a try/except block to prevent an exception from aborting webhook deletion. P1.F2.H1 shows a corresponding test. No relationship between the two PRs is established, so this chunk cannot be treated as a single conservative group. P1.F1.H1 is assessed; P1.F2.H1 is omitted from this chunk's observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a try/except ValueError block around api_key retrieval; returns a WebhookDeletionResult with success=False and a specific error message instead of raising an exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Stripe webhook cleanup: prevents the deletion workflow from aborting when OAuth credentials are unavailable, allowing the Hog function to remain disabled while reporting a graceful skip.
